title: Activation Sensitivity as a Unifying Principle for Post-Training Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2601.11663v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods for large language models compress pretrained weights to low bit-widths without retraining by optimizing layer-local proxy objectives. Activation-aware scaling methods such as AWQ protect input channels with large activation norms, whereas second-order error-compensation methods such as GPTQ redistribute rounding error using the inverse of the unweighted input covariance matrix. We show that both paradigms -- along with diagonal Fisher quantization, block reconstruction, and Hadamard rotation methods -- are special cases of minimizing a single loss-derived quadratic form governed by gradient-weighted activation sensitivity. From a Gauss-Newton expansion of the task loss at a linear layer $Y = X W^\top$, we prove that under isotropic output curvature the expected excess loss from weight perturbation $\Delta W$ reduces to $\frac{1}{2 d_{\mathrm{out}}}\operatorname{Tr}(\Delta W H_D \Delta W

translated_title: 激活敏感性作为训练后量化的统一原理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.11663v2 公告类型： replace-cross。摘要：面向大语言模型的训练后量化（PTQ）方法通过优化层级的代理目标函数，在不进行再训练的情况下将预训练权重压缩至低比特宽度。激活感知缩放方法（如AWQ）保护具有大激活范数的输入通道，而二阶误差补偿方法（如GPTQ）则利用未加权输入协方差矩阵的逆来重新分配舍入误差。我们证明，这两种范式——连同对角Fisher量化、块重构以及Hadamard旋转方法——都是最小化由梯度加权激活敏感性所支配的单一损失导出二次型的特例。基于线性层 $Y = X W^\top$ 处任务损失的Gauss-Newton展开，我们证明在各向同性输出曲率下，权重扰动 $\Delta W$ 引起的期望超额损失可简化为 $\frac{1}{2 d_{\mathrm{out}}}\operatorname{Tr}(\Delta W H_D \Delta W^\top)$ 形式的表达式。
tldr: 该论文证明AWQ、GPTQ、对角Fisher量化、块重构和Hadamard旋转等主流训练后量化方法都是最小化同一个由梯度加权激活敏感性支配的二次型损失的特殊情形，从而将这些方法统一在一个理论框架之下。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that mainstream post-training quantization methods—AWQ, GPTQ, diagonal Fisher quantization, block reconstruction, and Hadamard rotations—are all special cases of minimizing a single quadratic loss form governed by gradient-weighted activation sensitivity, thereby unifying these approaches under one theoretical framework.
